# OpenRide

> OpenRide (openride.bike) sells self-guided bike tours. Each route comes with day-by-day plans, lodging, food stops, shuttle and getting-home options, and GPX files. It is run by Chris VanDusen, who guided bicycle tours professionally for ten years.

The first route is the Natchez Trace Parkway in Mississippi and Tennessee, a 444-mile National Park Service road with no commercial traffic. The lower section, Natchez to Rocky Springs and beyond, is 82 miles and takes 3 to 4 days.

## Route pages

- [Natchez Trace Parkway overview](https://openride.bike/natchez-trace.html): the full 444 miles in three segments, with an FAQ on segments and beginners.
- [Lower Natchez Trace](https://openride.bike/natchez-trace-lower.html): 82 miles, 3 to 4 days, with an FAQ on direction, season, bikes, logistics, camping and cost.

## Home

- [OpenRide home](https://openride.bike/): all routes.
